messages:
incident-bot: ALERT resolved — Paging incident INC-2028-07: high error rate on /v1/generate. Root cause tagged: upstream KV cache invalidation event. Auto-bridge closed.

samir_oncall: quick recap — during the 14:12 PDT spike we saw a cascade of 502s from the runtime when the KV cache invalidation rolled through a subset of nodes. Traffic routing failed over to the slower fallback variant, which increased latencies and pushed client retries. I disabled the rolling invalidation and triggered a targeted restart for the 3 affected pools. Error rate returned to baseline at ~14:27.

alex_truong: thanks Samir. Can you paste the short mitigation timeline so CS has a clean version to use in comms?

samir_oncall: timeline (short):
- 14:10 — alert from SLO monitor (error rate > 3x baseline)
- 14:12 — incident page + bridge created by incident-bot
- 14:14 — confirmed KV invalidation on pool-gamma via /admin/kv/events
- 14:16 — switched routing to fallback-model-2 for impacted customers
- 14:18 — began targeted restarts for nodes n-gamma-1..3
- 14:27 — error rate back to normal, gradual failback initiated
- 14:35 — monitoring stable, bridge closed

maria_cs: that's great. Customer-facing summary we can use should be short and non-technical. Draft suggestion: "Between 14:10–14:35 we experienced elevated errors for text generation requests caused by an internal cache invalidation process. We mitigated the issue and are implementing safeguards to avoid recurrence. We will share a full RCA this week." Thoughts? @elaine-cs

elaine-cs: good tone. Can we commit to a date for the RCA share? Customers asked for a timebox.

jamie_w: I can own the public statuspage update + support digest. Proposed timeline: internal RCA draft by EOD Friday (2081290000), stakeholder review Monday, customer RCA distribution Tuesday. Anyone block?

alex_truong: EOD Friday works for the draft, but engineering needs a clear set of action items first. Samir, Sasha — can you list technical remediation steps and owners here so Jamie has something concrete for the status page?

sasha: putting action items here — will own the tracker.
- ACTION-1: Add fail-safe to KV invalidation job to ensure backoff + canary (owner: sasha, ETA: 2028-07-10)
- ACTION-2: Improve routing fallback health checks to avoid overload of fallback-model-2 (owner: samir_oncall, ETA: 2028-07-08)
- ACTION-3: Add alert that specifically detects cascading retries + increased client-side 429/502 pattern (owner: alex_truong, ETA: 2028-07-05)
- ACTION-4: Post-incident load test to validate failover scenario (owner: eng-performance, contact: jamie_w, ETA: 2028-07-12)

samir_oncall: small addition — will also add a short runbook snippet to the oncall playbook about when to pause invalidation jobs (owner: samir_oncall, ETA: 2028-07-06).

jamie_w: perfect. I'll draft the statuspage and support template once Sasha puts the action tracker rows into the shared spreadsheet (link: https://redwood.company/sheets/incident-2081234567). Draft text for status page (short):
"At 14:10 UTC we observed elevated errors affecting a subset of text-generation requests. We mitigated the issue by rerouting traffic and restarting a small group of nodes. Services have recovered; we are preparing a full RCA and corrective action plan."

maria_cs: tweak: say local time PDT not UTC, and mention ETA for RCA (to set customer expectations).

jamie_w: updated: "At 14:10 PDT we observed elevated errors affecting a subset of text-generation requests. We mitigated the issue by rerouting traffic and restarting a small group of nodes. Services have recovered; we will share a full RCA with next steps by Tuesday, 2028-07-16."

alex_truong: works. For the internal RCA note: we should include repro steps and the exact KV invalidation payload that triggered it. Samir, please add to the draft. Also include the log snippet:
```
[14:13:02] pool-gamma: received invalidation batch id=0x4f3c size=1.2MB
[14:13:03] pool-gamma: eviction loop blocked on flush -> queue growth > 256MB
[14:14:10] runtime: return 502 upstream: cache miss + overflow
```
samir_oncall: adding logs + repro to the doc now.

sasha: tracker link updated with rows + owners. I also added a priority column — marking ACTION-1/ACTION-2 as P0.

incident-bot: NOTE: handoff time — samir_oncall to alex_truong at 18:00 PDT.

samir_oncall: handing off to @alex_truong for overnight coverage. I'll be on-call until 18:00 and available for any questions after that.

alex_truong: taking handoff. I'll review the restart logs and keep watch on the SLO dashboard. If anything reoccurs I'll escalate immediately.

maria_cs: CS plan — Elaine will send personalized emails to affected accounts Wednesday morning; include the short status update + offer a scheduled 1:1 if they want a walkthrough.

elaine-cs: copy. I'll coordinate with Sales for any high-touch customers.

jamie_w: ACTION for me: publish statuspage entry + post to support digest (owner: jamie_w, ETA: 2081280000).

sasha: ACTION for me: follow up in 48 hours to confirm remediation progress and update tracker (owner: sasha, ETA: 2081312000).

alex_truong: proposed next steps checklist for this thread:
1) Engineering: finalize RCA draft (owner: samir_oncall + alex_truong)
2) CS: prep customer emails (owner: elaine-cs + maria_cs)
3) Public: statuspage (owner: jamie_w)
4) Tracker: fill in remediation evidence & test results (owner: sasha)
5) Share final RCA & action tracker with customers on Tue 2028-07-16

jamie_w: tagging folks for visibility: @sasha @samir_oncall @alex_truong @elaine-cs :thumbsup:

samir_oncall: quick admin — 1) logging this incident under INC-2028-07 in the postmortem board, 2) adding link to tracker in the incident doc. Link: https://redwood.company/incidents/INC-2028-07

alex_truong: thanks all. Closing this thread for active paging — keep the channel for updates to the tracker and RCA. Will reopen if paging resumes.

maria_cs: noted. Thanks everyone for the quick response.

elaine-cs: I'll wait for the RCA draft before emailing customers, ETA Tuesday. :white_check_mark:
